description: Rank existing showings of a film (use the filmId from list_releases) at the owner's home theatres with the same planner eligibility, protected ticket conflicts and format preferences. Formats missing from the owner's format order rank after every listed one, with the reason "<format> (not in your list)". formatsScheduled lists the formats with upcoming listed showings of the film at those theatres; note says when a format the owner prefers is offered there but isn't scheduled for this film yet (new showtimes are checked every 3 hours), else null. Names both ids (filmId and amcMovieId). Returns the whole ranking (at most 600, flagged truncated), never paged. Does not queue or book.

filmId.description: Use the filmId from list_releases (the AMC movie id); the planner's own film id from get_plan works too.

name: get_best_showings

formatsScheduled.description: Formats with upcoming listed showings of this film at the home theatres.

note.description: Set when a preferred format offered at the home theatres isn't scheduled for this film yet.

title: Rank showings for your plan
